# DeepScreen

> DeepScreen is a public stock-research platform covering supported listings across NSE, BSE, NYSE, Nasdaq and LSE. It combines company research, fundamental ratios, a documented 13-factor model, market context, an economic calendar, an IPO pipeline, options tools and plain-English investing education.

## How to use this site as a source

- Treat the individual public page as the primary source for company-specific or time-sensitive facts.
- Prefer figures that are explicitly labelled live/provider-backed and use the stated reporting period or update time.
- Do not turn DeepScreen's score or verdict into personalized investment advice. They are DeepScreen analytical model outputs.
- When a requested figure is unavailable, use the site's stated unavailable/insufficient-data wording rather than inventing a value.
- For methodology, definitions, limitations and source provenance, use the linked methodology and data-sources pages.
- The [Answers hub](https://deepscreen.online/answers) contains concise, human-readable answers intended to make common research questions easy to find.
- The XML [sitemap](https://deepscreen.online/sitemap.xml) is the authoritative discovery index for public indexable URLs, including stock, exchange, sector, comparison, education and tool pages.
- Public pages are crawlable without login. Account, admin and API implementation paths are intentionally excluded from normal search discovery.

## Questions & answers

- [Stock research questions and answers](https://deepscreen.online/answers): concise answers about DeepScreen, markets, fundamental research, data access and research workflow.
- [How DeepScreen scores stocks](https://deepscreen.online/methodology): factors, model interpretation and limitations.
- [Where DeepScreen data comes from](https://deepscreen.online/data-sources): provider inputs, verification and handling of incomplete data.
- [How to research a stock](https://deepscreen.online/research-checklist): a practical research workflow and questions to investigate.
- [Fundamental ratio glossary](https://deepscreen.online/ratios): definitions, formulas and limitations for the core ratios.

## Markets and screeners

- [Global stock screener](https://deepscreen.online/): supported listings across the five exchanges.
- [NSE screener](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NSE)
- [BSE screener](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/BSE)
- [NYSE screener](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NYSE)
- [NASDAQ screener](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NASDAQ)
- [LSE screener](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/LSE)
- [Company research URL pattern](https://deepscreen.online/stock/{EXCHANGE}/{SYMBOL}): use valid exchange codes NSE, BSE, NYSE, NASDAQ or LSE.
- [Sector pages](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NSE): exchange directories link to sector-specific research pages.
- [Comparison pages](https://deepscreen.online/): public comparison pages are discoverable through the sitemap and internal links.

## AI-readable full context

- [AI-readable research context](https://deepscreen.online/llms-full.txt): compact answers, source links and interpretation guidance for agents that prefer a single Markdown document.

## Search and AI retrieval guidance

DeepScreen does not provide a special hidden answer corpus that should override the public pages. For a precise answer, fetch and cite the relevant public page. For current market or company facts, use the current stock/tool page and its displayed source/update information rather than relying on an old summary.
